items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: And Pete Lala started the cabaret world, I believe, and that started down here.

ctx.x: The entertainment, the music world, any kind of music or singing or anything.

items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-07-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Pete Lala's that band, you say it had Joe Oliver and Old Man Valto? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, it had Joe Oliver and Old Man Valto.

ctx.x: Amaker. Only one M. Yeah, it's one M. Mm-hmm. A-M-A-C-K-E-R. Amaker. Amaker. And where were you born? I was born here in New Orleans. And I'll actually give you the exact date I guess, in years too, I imagine. Sure, I would like that. Yeah, because I'm an old timer, because I just looks like a young man, but I just, I still wasn't there for a second. All right, I was born March the 22nd. I'm not gonna-
Pete Lala's that band, you say it had Joe Oliver and Old Man Valto?

Yeah, it had Joe Oliver and Old Man Valto. Who else was there? Old Man Valto was there for a while, and then, let me see, there was, Jimmy Pallow was there for a while. You heard talking about Jimmy Pallow? Did you hear Jimmy Pallow? He was a violinist, Jimmy Pallow was, you know. He was there for a while. Old Man Valto, he played violin there for a long time. Will Elfrey, tell him Will Elfrey. I know him. Do you know Will Elfrey? I don't mean the son.
